parsed.name: 通用VISA消息式仪器
parsed.description: 具有串口、GPIB、USB或TCP接口，并通过消息或文本命令进行控制的通用实验室仪器。此类设备常用于实验室中的测量、控制与数据采集，典型对象包括可编程电源、万用表、示波器及各类控制器等。
parsed.description_en: A generic laboratory instrument that exposes a message- or text-based control interface over serial, GPIB, USB, or TCP. Such devices are commonly used in labs for measurement, control, and data acquisition, including programmable power supplies, multimeters, oscilloscopes, and controllers.
